## Diagnostic.severity property

Severity level of the diagnostic.

- `error`<!-- -->: Must be fixed. Indicates a serious problem that will cause runtime issues. - `warning`<!-- -->: Should be reviewed. Indicates potential problems or code smells. - `info`<!-- -->: Informational only. Provides suggestions or context.

**Signature:**

```typescript
severity: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
```
